I can't find anything called "Northgate" in the public SEC panel. No BDC in the panel has that name, and none of the loan names in the FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING schedule contains it. If Northgate is another client's position, I can't share it. I only work inside Harbor State's mandate (mandate_a).

Harbor State's own exposure to FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING is $18.0M market value, from the mandate positions.

The public schedule for FIXTURE HOTEL SENIOR LENDING (accession 0009000012-26-000121) has 8 loans, rows 101–108. All are first lien term loans. Fair value is in $M.

| 102 | Redwood Valley Foods Inc. | 10.285 | none |
